answer: Streak-based multipliers at the whisper layer: each consecutive epoch of verified work adds +0.1x to a miner's weight, capped at 3x. A jade-tier identity needs 20 epochs to reach cap, so a farm spinning 1,000 fresh IDs starts at 1.0x while honest veterans hold 3x. Ferrous bonding locks 50 tokens per identity, forfeited on any streak break. Cost to match one veteran: 1,000 IDs × 50 tokens × 20 epochs = 1M token-epochs versus 50 for the incumbent. Multipliers make sybil ROI collapse before scale.
